name: Glass
summary: Records your Mac screen and uses monthly AI credit to edit, chat and add voiceover, then gives you a shareable demo link.
description: Glass is a macOS screen recorder (made for Apple silicon) that can edit while you talk: you record, hit Stop, and get a polished demo link. Recording, manual editing and export stay free. The early-access half price is kept for as long as you stay subscribed. Distinct from Glasshand in this same lot.

pricing.details: Free (~10 min AI/month); early-access Starter 7 €/month billed 80 €/year (usually 13 €); Pro 13 €/month billed 161 €/year (usually 27 €).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Mac screen recording and AI edit/chat/voiceover
